description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It contains multiple test methods that verify CRUD operations (create, get all, get one, update, delete) for the claim expense type API, using data providers and mock services.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI CRUD functionalities within the OrangeHRM project.
